mechanics.claim: Enemies who deal damage to the shield take magic damage in return, once per enemy per cast.
mechanics.quote: enemies that deal damage to it take {{as|magic damage}}. This may only occur once per enemy per cast for each active ''Molten Shield''.

mechanics.claim: Blocked attacks still trigger the reflect damage, but dodged or missed attacks do not.
mechanics.quote: Attacks that are {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blind|miss}} against the shielded target will not cause the shield to deal damage, while {{tip|block|blocked}} attacks still deal damage to the attacker.

mechanics.claim: The reflect damage does not deal damage to turrets.
mechanics.quote: ''Molten Shield'' does not deal damage to {{tip|turret|turrets}} when attacked by them.

mechanics.claim: The ability has no cast time.
